title: GalaxyRealms
description: GalaxyRealms is a community SMP Minecraft server with galaxy-themed survival gameplay. No mods required.
body:
🌌 **GalaxyRealms SMP**

**GalaxyRealms** is a community focused **Survival Multiplayer Minecraft server** where players can explore, build, and thrive in a galaxy inspired world. Whether you're a builder, explorer, or adventurer, GalaxyRealms offers a welcoming environment and exciting gameplay for everyone.

Our server is designed to provide a **smooth and enjoyable experience** for players around the world, with **EU and USA servers** to ensure stable performance and low latency.

--------------------

 ###  **Features**
 
 • **_Survival Multiplayer (SMP)_**  
 • **_Galaxy themed world and builds_**  
 • **_Friendly and active community_**  
 • **_EU & USA serves_**
 • **_Community events_**  
 • **_Player driven economy_**  
 • **_Custom plugins_**  

--------------------

###  **Join the Server**

You do **not** need any mods to play simply join using **vanilla Minecraft**.

**IP:** `smp.galaxyrealms.com`

--------------------
### 💬 **Community**

Join our Discord to chat with the community, get updates, and participate in events.

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/BX7MWZeY8w

--------------------
### 🛒 **Store**

Support the server and unlock perks through our official store.

**Website / Store:** https://store.galaxyrealms.com/

--------------------

✨ **Start your adventure and create your own realm in the galaxy!**
